title: Training Note — Integration Protocols and Third-Party Devices Supported under the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Training Note — Integration Protocols and Third-Party Devices Supported under the Building Automation Service Plans

**Which integration protocols does each tier of the Building Automation Service Plans support?** The supported protocols are a per-tier mapping of protocol to whether it is covered:

| Protocol | Controls Help Desk Subscription | Alarm Monitoring Plan | Scheduled Controls Service Plan | Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | Remote Optimization Plan | Integrated Building Automation Partnership |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BACnet/IP | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| BACnet MS/TP | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Modbus TCP | not covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| LonWorks | not covered | not covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| MQTT | not covered | not covered | not covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Niagara Fox | not covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |

**Are devices from other manufacturers on the same network supported?** Third-party device support is set per tier:

| Tier | Third-party device support |
|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | not supported |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | not supported |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | supported |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | supported |
| Remote Optimization Plan | supported |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | supported |

**Which is the lowest tier covering every protocol in the mapping?** The Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan: it is the first tier at which MQTT is covered, and every other protocol is already covered at or below it.

**Which is the lowest tier covering LonWorks?** The Scheduled Controls Service Plan.
